description: Fetch a sutta by id (e.g. "dn22", "mn1", "sn56.11") — the Pali text (Mahāsaṅgīti) of every segment. Pali only by default; pass langs for translations, translators to name a translator (e.g. ["en_sujato"]), editions for the whole text of other Pali editions line by line (the whole canon, see compare_editions). Same data as dhamma.gift/api/text.

editions.description: Other Pali editions to add, each segment beside the Mahāsaṅgīti: bjt (Buddha Jayanti, Sri Lanka), my (Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana, Myanmar), th (Siam Rath, Thailand), mso (Mahāsaṅgīti as printed, 2005), pts (Pali Text Society), or ["all"]. The whole canon (gaps: https://dhamma.gift/docs/compare).

langs.description: Translation languages to include, e.g. ["ru","en"]. Default: none (Pali only).

suttaId.description: Sutta id, e.g. dn22, mn1, sn56.11.

translators.description: Explicit translator keys, e.g. ["en_sujato"] to include Sujato.

name: get_text
